chunks: So I remained patient during the long period and the severity of the trial, until when he went his way (of death), he placed the matter in a group, claiming that I was one of them. By God and the Consultation! When did doubt overtake me alongside the first of them, so that I became paired with these counterparts?

key_terms.الشُّورَى: The Consultation (referring to the council of six companions who chose Uthman)
key_terms.الْمُدَّةِ: The period of time (between the Prophet's death and Ali's caliphate)

ai.seo_question: What is Imam Ali's view on the Shura (consultation) and his inclusion in the group of Caliphs?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) laments his prolonged patience during the 'interval of caliphate' (Fatra), where authority was entrusted to the Shura companions who nominally included him but effectively excluded his rightful precedence. He expresses deep indignation at being equated with them in governance despite his superior status and lack of doubt, highlighting the Shia view of his delayed but legitimate claim to leadership.
